A dependency update: the MCP SDK moves to 1.32.1.

## Security

- **MCP SDK 1.32.1** (from 1.30.0). It fixes five advisories against earlier SDK versions:
  - [GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h): the OAuth client could send credentials to an authorization server the MCP server chose.
  - [GHSA-22jm-h49p-29qw](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-22jm-h49p-29qw): experimental tasks were not tied to the session that created them.
  - [GHSA-6prh-2h8m-c8cw](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6prh-2h8m-c8cw): HTTP client transports followed cross-origin redirects with custom headers.
  - [GHSA-46jr-4wx8-v453](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-46jr-4wx8-v453): one HTTP request could exhaust server memory during validation.
  - [GHSA-rvq5-wwqv-78pq](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rvq5-wwqv-78pq): server bearer authentication accepted tokens issued for another service.

  None of these reached this server: it speaks stdio only, with no HTTP transport, OAuth or tasks. But it declared `^1.30.0`, so security scanners reading the package reported all five. It now requires the fixed version.

No tool, input, output or default changed.
